name: Inventory-skewed LP allocation
hypothesis: Allocate less buying-side liquidity when token inventory exceeds its target, using a declared bin/range rule.
spec: Setup: Asymmetric liquidity may reduce unwanted accumulation of a risky token. Entry: Allocate less buying-side liquidity when token inventory exceeds its target, using a declared bin/range rule. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Withdraw on inventory or total-loss limit, not by adding unlimited capital. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs AMM liquidity-position simulation (fees, ranges, impermanent loss)
